new_value: Done and committed (f4a1b9c6), gates green: 2177 tests pass. The follower records its position per room, reads a jump as a gap, asks the hub via POST /catchUp/{roomId} discovered from its directory's unknown members, applies recovered fanout through the same path a live /notify uses, and on a 410 records an unfillable gap that counts once against follower_room.gone so clients resync (decision .8). Driven by three decisions: fill on detection, guarded per room (.9); never re-ask an unfillable gap (.10); probe every room at startup and every 15 min, because the gap in the fanout missed MOST RECENTLY has no later fanout to reveal it (.11). Also fixed a false gap on rejoining (.12) and a loop a hub could spin by answering without advancing. NOT tested against another implementation: bead .104.5 is the two-provider test.
